thread:
sara (platform): @channel Heads-up: we are opening Dedicated capacity for a new GPU SKU — NVIDIA H200 80GB (catalog name: h200-80) in two regions: eu-central-1 and ap-south-1. Reservations open Mon 2026-04-06 09:00 UTC.

max (infra): short perf note: h200-80 shows ~1.6x throughput vs h100 for long-context transformer workloads in our bench runs (50k token mix). Latency SLOs remain the same, but expect slight P99 jitter during first day of traffic as autoscale warms. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

ashwin (sales): are we changing pricing for dedicated on this SKU or is it parity with h100 pricing? need to update quotes for enterprise deals.

sara (platform): pricing is a new SKU — list price will be 1.25x h100 baseline in the console; discounts apply per reserved commit. Sales decks will be updated tomorrow. For immediate quoting, use the transient pricing matrix in the internal pricing doc (link pasted in runbook). @ashwin (sales) I can DM the table.

lina (solutions): migration note for customers on h100: if they want to move, we support in-place rollovers. Important: KV cache compatibility differs for quantized variants — run the migration checker in the console first. I'll post a short checklist in eng-docs.

ops-bot: Capacity orchestration job scheduled: reserve-capacity-job-1763876000 created for eu-central-1/ap-south-1; expected allocation window 2026-04-06..2026-04-08.

max (infra): small operational detail — for ap-south-1 we are shipping with NVLink disabled (vendor constraints) so multi-card throughput will be slightly lower; call out to customers with heavy multi-gpu sharding.

ashwin (sales): understood. any quota limits per org for GA reservation? want to prevent overcommit by a single customer.

sara (platform): initial soft quota: 64 GPUs per org across both regions. For larger needs, escalate to capacity@redwood with expected commit size and duration. We'll enforce by reservation approval queue for first 30 days.

lina (solutions): here's the CLI snippet for reserving from tomorrow (internal-only):

```
rw capacity reserve --region eu-central-1 --sku h200-80 --count 4 --start 2026-04-06T09:00Z --end 2026-10-06T09:00Z --purpose migration-demo
```

sara (platform): runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/dedicated-h200 (contains release notes, perf numbers, rollback steps). Please read before approving customer requests.

max (infra): monitoring hooks added to console metrics: model_inference_gpu_util_h200, h200_temp_celsius, h200_oom_events. Alerting default: P95 GPU util > 85% for 10m.

ashwin (sales): will update customer-facing FAQ. Can someone add a short blurb for sales ops about RPO/SLA differences?

lina (solutions): I will. Also: if any customer hits quantization regressions with 4-bit ams, route to eng-ml with the prompt set and eval id.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy to dedicated-controlplane-eu started at 2026-03-22T22:15:00Z (job 8423). No blocking alerts in first 45m.

sara (platform): Thanks all. TL;DR: H200 80GB becoming available in eu-central-1 & ap-south-1, reservations open 2026-04-06, soft quota 64 GPUs/org, pricing = 1.25x h100 list. Ping me or capacity@redwood for edge cases. :rocket:
